import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        // Initialize ans array with zeros
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 20; ++j) {
                ans[i][j] = 0; // Placeholder, actual initialization as in original code
            }
        }

        // Compute ncr array
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; ++b) {
                if (b > a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 0;
                } else if (b == 0 || b == a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 1;
                } else {
                    ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
                }
            }
        }

        // Read input
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        long n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[(int)n][(int)n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[(int)n + 1][(int)n + 1];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[(int)a][(int)(R - 1)] * ncr[(int)b][(int)(R - 1)];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; ++b) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
            }
        }

        for (int a = 1; a <= n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1] + blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        long[][] revarea = new long[(int)n + 1][(int)n + 1];
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; ++b) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[(int)n][(int)n] - totalarea[(int)n][(int)(n - a)] - totalarea[(int)(n - b)][(int)n] + totalarea[(int)(n - a)][(int)(n - b)];
            }
        }

        int d = (int)n;

        // Using nested HashMaps to simulate map<LL, LL> dp[n+1][n+1]
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new HashMap[(int)n + 1][(int)n + 1];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new HashMap[(int)n + 1][(int)n + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }

        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int)R][(int)C];
        long totalArea = totalarea[(int)n][(int)n];
        long m1 = (-best + totalArea) / 2;
        long m2 = totalArea - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[(int)n][(int)(y + 1)] - totalarea[(int)n][(int)y];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = entry.getValue();
                        dp[x][y + 1].put(area2, dp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + prevCount);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int)n][(int)(n)] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[(int)(n - x)][(int)(n - (y + 1))];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = entry.getValue();
                        bp[x][y + 1].put(area2, bp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + prevCount);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[x + 1][(int)n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = entry.getValue();
                        dp[x + 1][y].put(c, dp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(c, 0L) + prevCount);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int)(n - x)][(int)(n - y)] - totalarea[(int)(n - x - 1)][(int)(n - y)];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey();
                        if (c + newarea > m2) continue;
                        long prevCount = entry.getValue();
                        bp[x + 1][y].put(c + newarea, bp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(c + newarea, 0L) + prevCount);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp[x][y].clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp[x][y].clear();
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; ++x) {
            int y = (int)(d - x);
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long val1 = m1 - c;
                long val2 = m2 - c;
                if (val1 >= 0 && val1 <= m2) {
                    long count1 = bp[n - x][n - y].getOrDefault(val1, 0L);
                    bestfreq += freq * count1;
                }
                if (m1 != m2 && val2 >= 0 && val2 <= m2) {
                    long count2 = bp[n - x][n - y].getOrDefault(val2, 0L);
                    bestfreq += freq * count2;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
